integrity: Exact finite enumeration and witness identities were checked in a standalone C++17 program; no external or independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: One vaccine, a uniform post-vaccine initial infection, independent homogeneous directed arc transmissibility, and strongly connected finite directed graphs; no claim for undirected graphs, alternate vaccine sampling, multi-vaccine strategies, or real epidemic effectiveness.
title: Sharp small-network failures of forward-acquaintance vaccination in directed epidemics
